summary: Tiny steep road end beside a house and pool, 9 m from a dwelling.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room off the road

drivers.seclusion: Houses and a pool sit beside the line; dwellings at 9 m and 12 m, with trees around.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow road end with hatched markings and no verge; nowhere to pull clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Very quiet short dead end off Ironside Street.
drivers.convention: No signs; one car parked at the road bend, no camping seen.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shading it from the north and west.
